title: God Created You for Relationship Not Rituals
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he launches a new series on the power of praise and worship, exploring the biblical foundation for our relationship with God. You'll discover why God created us for a spirit-to-spirit connection with Him, and how praise and worship can transform your life as you experience a deeper, more intimate relationship with your Heavenly Father. This sermon will inspire you to reorient your focus on what truly matters in your relationship with God.
